content_of_post_to_answer: Which time of day do you find it hardest to stay focused on your recovery?
answer: The hardest part of recovery is often not the time when discipline is lowest, but the time when the mind starts negotiating. For many people that happens in the evening, when fatigue makes old habits feel like relief rather than a setback. I’ve written more about this pattern and the hidden psychology behind it on my profile, if you want to explore it further. Recovery is not just resisting a behavior; it is learning to recognize the moments when your brain asks for comfort in familiar ways.
